payload.title: Mark Zuckerberg building AI co-CEO system to manage Meta operations
payload.content: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg has confirmed he is developing an AI system capable of serving as a co-CEO to help manage Meta's operations. The project is part of Zuckerberg's broader push to integrate AI agents into Meta's executive and operational decision-making, reducing reliance on human management layers.
